name: Thalassophile
source:
The sole occupant of a lonely lighthouse, Llewellyn should have a simple life full of boring reports and mundane observations. But when an offshore lab sinks in a freak accident, oceanographers across the international coastline are put on edge. 

Every day, Llewellyn dives beneath the waves to monitor the marine life for disease, and every day things grow stranger. When something drags itself ashore alongside him, Llewellyn must figure out how to keep both himself and it alive while uncovering what it is, where it came from, and whether anyone else should ever learn of this mistake of nature at all.

[From [url=https://fishfoodgames.itch.io/thalassophile]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为一座孤寂灯塔里唯一的守塔人，卢埃林原本该过着充满枯燥报告与日常观测的平淡生活。然而当一座近海实验室在一场离奇事故中沉没后，整条国际海岸线上的海洋学家们顿时人人自危。

日复一日，卢埃林潜入海浪之下监测海洋生物是否感染疫病，而海底的景象也一天比一天诡异。当某个东西随着他一同挣扎着爬上海岸时，卢埃林必须设法让自己与这头生物双双活下去，同时查明它究竟是什么、来自何方——以及，究竟该不该让世上其他任何人知晓这个大自然的错误造物。
